design_decisions: Board of record = Hermes native ~/.hermes/kanban.db (single write authority; dashboard is view+API layer per spec)
Writes go through hermes_cli.kanban_db in-process (same code path as hermes kanban CLI) — never raw SQL
Sidecar telemetry.db for fields the native schema lacks: live activity strings, progress %, standalone agent heartbeats, repo/log links
SSE for live updates; snapshot hash diff every 1.5s; full-snapshot push (board is small)
Reads unauthenticated on LAN (same trust model as hermes-webui :8787); ALL writes require Bearer token
stdlib only — no deps, PEP 668 safe on Pi
Unassigned ready tasks never dispatch (dispatcher requires real-profile assignee) — safe API testing
